thread:
alex: Heads up — canary promotion stalled at prefetch step, deploybot shows a cache lease deadlock.
deploybot: :warning: Promotion paused. stage=canary step=prefetch error="cache-lease: deadlock" retries=5/5. Full log snippet below:
```
2025-02-12T14:12:33Z prefetchtask: acquiring lease for shard=kv-17
2025-02-12T14:12:33Z prefetchtask: lease blocked, owner=unknown, waiting
2025-02-12T14:12:36Z prefetchtask: retrying (5/5)
2025-02-12T14:12:38Z prefetchtask: error: cache-lease: deadlock
```
maria: ugh. this smells like the cache-ttl eviction + concurrent prefetch we saw last month. any chance to fall back?
sam: is this a transient node-level problem or an orchestrator deadlock? can we force another prefetch node?
alex: logs show owner=unknown which usually means the lease table got orphaned after a failed write. fallback options: 1) pin to last-good image (sha: abcdef1234) and promote manually, 2) attempt manual cache cleanup (risky during change window), 3) wait 20-30m for the system to recover.
jen: change window is live for another 40m. leadership prefers not to wait if we can pin. also we need release notes updated if we pin.
lisa: agree with pin. we should also create a follow-up ticket to run a KV table compaction and add a deploybot guard for lease orphans. i'll open the ticket now.
maria: can we do a quick smoke after pin? need to verify canary behavior with the pinned image.
sam: manual promote steps: 1) set image tag -> sha=abcdef1234 on canary route 2) kick deploybot with `--manual-promote` 3) run smoke job `smoke/canary-basic` 4) monitor latency/cost dashboards for 10m.
alex: i'll do the pin now. tagging @deploybot to accept manual promote.
deploybot: acknowledged. manual promote queued: target=canary image=sha:abcdef1234 initiated_by=alex. smoke job auto-triggered.
jen: I'll update the release notes: add entry "Pinned canary to previous image due to prefetch cache lease deadlock; follow-up remediation planned."
lisa: ticket created: INF-2749 "KV lease orphan compaction + guard" assigned to eng-infra. linking in release thread.
maria: smoke passed (0/5 tests flaky, basic checks OK). looks clear.
alex: promote completed, canary healthy. change window preserved. marking this release as green; follow-up postmortem owner = lisa. :thumbsup:
jen: will notify PMs and docs. thanks team.
lisa: leaving a note in the deploy run: "manual-pin -> abcdef1234 due to cache-lease deadlock; follow-up INF-2749"
alex: closing thread, will monitor metrics for next hour.
